name: QPrey 2: House Arrest
source: After surviving the incidents at the lake house, Tom and Claudia face unwarranted punishment for a crime they didn't commit. Confined within the familiar walls of the place he knows, Tom must harness his newfound, unexpected ability to unveil the truth and protect his loved ones, all while being under the watchful eyes of an even bigger monster.​
translation: 在湖边小屋的事件中幸存下来后，汤姆和克劳迪娅因他们没有犯下的罪行而面临无理的惩罚。汤姆被限制在他熟悉的地方熟悉的围墙内，必须利用他新发现的、意想不到的能力来揭露真相并保护他所爱的人，同时还要面对一个更大的怪物的监视。
